title: Mechanisms of infantile hemangioma involution (Review).
snippet: Infantile hemangioma (IH) is the most common benign vascular tumor of infancy, characterized by a distinctive life cycle of rapid postnatal proliferation followed by spontaneous involution. title: Assessment of a direct fluorescence-based cell-free DNA assay for evaluating the extent of metastatic dissemination: An exploratory study.
